## For unsafe-content reports only

If you believe a PoC published here could meaningfully help attack a system
that is **not** yet patched, please redact specific exploitation details from
this issue and contact the maintainer privately via the GitHub profile in
[docs/SECURITY.md](../../docs/SECURITY.md). A short notice here is fine; full
detail belongs in the private channel.
